text:
li: quick heads-up, i'm going to push v2b-onnx (4bit-mix) to 5% traffic on the user-docs slice in ~15m. want to confirm fallback thresholds before i flip it on.

devon: 👍 what metrics are we gating on?

li: concordance drop > 2.5% OR latency p99 increase > 120ms OR error_rate > 0.3% for 10m window triggers immediate rollback.

maya: can we make the concordance check slice-weighted? last time doc-heavy slices skewed global.

li: yes — plan is slice-weighted. threshold config i'll use: 
```yaml
thresholds:
  concordance_delta_pct: 2.5
  latency_p99_ms: 120
  error_rate_pct: 0.3
  window_minutes: 10
  slice_weighting: true
  min_samples_per_slice: 50
```

sam: minor ask: add a soft-alert at 1.0% concordance drop (non-blocking) so oncall can eyeball before auto rollback.

li: good call. i'll add soft_alert_cutoff: 1.0 in the config.

devon: also ensure KV-cache hit ratio is included — we saw prefix cache changes affect quality a bit. maybe require hit_ratio_delta_pct < 5.

li: ok adding `kv_hit_ratio_delta_pct: 5` as a secondary signal (non-blocking for rollback but included in the incident blurb).

ops-bot: reminder: deploy window is 14:30-15:30 UTC. Auto-rollback enabled.

maya: when you flip, can you post the sample diff job id so we can run quick spot checks? last time i found a prompt family that regressed.

li: will do. sample job will be `sample-diff-18290-1`. i'll paste link when it's up.

sam: if we hit the soft alert, what's the runbook?

maya: soft alert -> paging policy: p90 oncall -> quick manual sample review -> if unclear, throttle to 2% and run 1h more.

li: launching in 10m. config posted to infra: `infra/rollouts/v2b-staged.yml`. i'll ping with the job link right after flip.

devon: fine by me. +1 on soft alerts.

li: flip done — 5% live. sample job: https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/sample-diff-18290-1

ops-bot: monitoring started. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/r/18290 (alerts wired)

maya: looking at first 5k calls, no obvious semantic drift. latency up ~30ms p99.

sam: soft alert fired: concordance down 1.2% in docs slice. paging suppressed (soft).

li: noted. throttling to 2% while we inspect.

devon: digging into hit-levels, kv hit ratio down 3.8% for that slice, could explain some.

maya: i pulled sample set 42 from the job — a handful of edge cases diverge but overall ok. leaning to continue but keep 2% until end of window.

li: agreed. i'll hold at 2% for 45m, watch auto-rollback triggers. thanks all.
